notes.title: Mall Town update is live!
notes.notes:
Our first update is live! This small update includes some high priority bug fixes and some quality of life improvements there were called out by the Community.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented store combos from saving correctly.
[*] Removing large store no longer replaces it with a small store that faces the wrong direction.
[*] Improved minigame randomization so it more evenly chooses from all possible minigames.
[*] Improved shopper pathfinding to reduce the occurrence of shoppers getting stuck in the hallways.
[*] Added additional callouts to direct players in how to start a minigames
[*] Fixed the slingshot behaving randomly when dropped.
[*] Fixed the fire extinguisher behaving randomly when dropped.
[*] The Information Counter's icon will no longer appear during minigames.
[/list]
